features.qualification_or_extension: Bounded curved enrollment, topology/units capability contract

features.qualification_or_extension: Remote set creation, share/history edits and declared/effective field parity

features.title: Source palette / set

features.qualification_or_extension: Typed source kinds and distinct slot/geometry count semantics

features.mcp: Read pool references, cached membership and helper label/identity/context/status; no reconciliation

features.title: Source transforms/radii / set row

features.title: Population/seed / layer

features.title: Budget/target/refill / layer

features.title: Density map / layer
